newsitem.title: USA: Premisys seen as good buy - report.
newsitem.headline: Premisys seen as good buy - report.

text.p: Premisys Communications Inc's stock price is expected to recover from a hard fall after having missed two quarterly earnings estimates, according to the U.S. weekly business magazine, Business Week.
A column in the magazine's latest issue quoted the editor of the California Technology Stock Letter as saying the company was a good buy.

Last May, its stock rose to $65 a share, or 116 times earnings, before gradually falling back to $8, Mike Murphy told the column, Inside Wall Street. The stock fell to $8 after Premisys missed July's quarterly estimates and then announced it would miss them again for the March quarter, he said.
"We think most of the damage has been done to the stock price and that a bottom has been set," he was cited as saying, adding that his target for the stock was $22.

Premisys, which makes integrated-access products for telecommunications providers like Motorola Inc, blamed delays in shipments and a lost contract by a partner for failing to meet March quarter estimates.
On Thursday, its stock closed at $8-7/8 on the Nasdaq against the previous day's $8.
